Overview

Oita is a city in with a population of 475,000. Known as the hot spring capital of Japan, with the highest concentration of onsen in the country and a relaxed lifestyle. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
